meteredUsage: No charge amount exposed by TUI; no claim of free or $0 usage.
limitations: macOS interactive canary only; no Linux live verification or full record-type certification.
Parallel same-file reads without a unique active call retain path/digest references.
Native hook calls are authoritative; transcript calls lacking native IDs retain a distinct deterministic fallback view.
Private candidates expire after 60 seconds while the bounded cleanup worker can run; after a hard reboot, the next hook removes stale files and expired candidates cannot be replayed.
validation_note: The actual canary verified native hook body binding. Subsequent no-inference regressions verify deterministic transcript identities, permission/ambiguity handling, expiry, malformed provenance, and binary retention.
